justification: Both surfaces present shallow, rounded, schematic relief carvings built from the same limited vocabulary: ring/disc motifs, paired crescent or arc shapes, curvilinear bands and abstracted anthropomorphic heads with hand-like appendages, and in both a central ring is flanked or overhung by curved forms. The clearest difference is composition: A is a horizontal frieze of repeated crouching creature-figures facing along the surface, whereas B distributes isolated symbols vertically over a body-shaped surface with no interacting figures.
